# Security policy

Report vulnerabilities privately using [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/jarymor-ux/kee-route-manager/security/advisories/new). Do not attach live subscriptions, credentials, UUIDs, router backups or diagnostic archives to public issues.

The maintained stable and candidate lines target Keenetic/Netcraze routers; new fixes require new signed releases, never replacement of immutable assets. Individual models remain experimental pending documented hardware acceptance. Automatic update application is disabled; explicit installation is permitted only through the signed stable-launcher flow. A separate remote UI is a management client, not a second controller/router target. See [security boundaries](../docs/SECURITY.md), [hardware scope](../docs/HARDWARE.md) and [known limitations](../docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md).
